reapack.name: ReaScratch
reapack.desc: ReaScratch: DJ decks that scratch audio and video together

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0 \fswiss Helvetica;}}\f0\pard\b ReaScratch\b0\par\par Two DJ decks in REAPER that scratch both audio and video of a clip together, played from a DJ controller (MIDI) or the mouse.\par\par \b After installing:\b0 run the action \i Script: reascratch_setup.lua\i0 once (it creates the tracks, loads the JSFX, and adds the other scripts to the action list).\par\par The manual (PDF, Japanese and English) and the optional HID bridge are available on GitHub Releases.\par}
